{"metadata":{"type":"page"},"title":"📄 LTC-PRO","url":"https://app.notion.com/p/61c3dd29567d835ea606019eb29af383","text":"Here is the result of "view" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/61c3dd29567d835ea606019eb29af383 as of 2026-07-17T19:02:20.424Z: {"title":"LTC-PRO"} **\[Image Description: LTC-PRO Device Interface\]** The LTC-PRO is a web tension controller unit featuring a light blue, square panel enclosure secured by four corner screws. It includes a color LCD touchscreen display that reads "F-target 50", "Select Recipe 1", "F-Actual 11", and "P.Break Actual 0.00" alongside graphical menu icons. Below and above the screen are physical membrane keys (including power, menu, up, down, and operation functions) paired with indicator LEDs. ## Product Overview At Puretronics, we specialize in precision-engineered solutions for web tension management, empowering industries with the control and consistency needed for high-performance production. Our advanced line of Web Tension Controllers is designed to deliver accurate, real-time tension regulation across unwind, intermediate, and rewind zones-critical for maintaining material integrity and optimizing process efficiency. Here we introduce LTC-PRO our new launch for Web Tension Control with elegant touch screen display, better control and enhanced means of communication option making it a great option in today's time of connectivity. Whether you're processing paper, film, foil, textiles, or laminates, Puretronics controllers integrate seamlessly with new or retrofitted machinery, delivering measurable improvements in throughput, material yield, and product quality. Our systems are engineered for precision, built for durability, and backed by application expertise that ensures optimal performance in even the most demanding industrial environments. ## Technical Details
**Parameter** **Specification**
**Power Supply** 24Vdc ± 10%
**User Interface** Colour LCD with Touchscreen, Keys and LED indications
**Strain Gauge Channels** 2
